canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON with lexicographically sorted object keys; arrays retain declared order
correction_policy: Corrections create a successor package linked to superseded_package_id; originals are never overwritten.

video_component.standalone_claim_limit: Video corroborates process provenance but cannot alone establish rainfall quantity, water quality, custody, authenticity or compliance.

promotion_rules.REPORTABLE: All required provenance, time, coordinate, unit, methodology and quality fields pass configured rules.
promotion_rules.VALIDATED: Reportable evidence passes deterministic reconciliation and review rules.
promotion_rules.VERIFIED: Authorized independent review confirms the evidence package and linked records.
promotion_rules.ANCHORED: The canonical evidence root has been successfully anchored to an approved blockchain network.
